title: Evaluation of the constructed circuit
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\\{0,1\\}^n\\to\\{0,1\\}$ be a Boolean function, and let $k$ be a natural number with $k\\le n$. The circuit constructed from $f$ and $k$ computes $f$: on every input $x\\in\\{0,1\\}^n$, its output is $f(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ bits
